versions.changelog:
csv-documentation-generator v1.6.4

- Updated version to 1.6.4 in SKILL.md.
- Documentation files (CHANGELOG.md, README.md, etc.) updated to reflect latest features and standards.
- No interface or functionality changes; update is documentation-focused.

**Adds standards support, language options, and code annotation features.**

- Added standards references with the new STANDARDS.md and standards/code-annotations.json for improved regulatory alignment.
- Introduced `--language` and enhanced `--bilingual` options for flexible single/bilingual documentation generation.
- Example templates for major document types are now included.
- Code requirement parsing now supports non-interactive mode with `--auto-add`.
- Expanded documentation, including a new prompts.md and clearer standards for outputs.
- Internal scripts significantly updated to integrate standards and language handling.

csv-documentation-generator v1.3.4

- Updated skill version and metadata to 1.3.4 in SKILL.md and documentation.
- README and documentation files refreshed for improved clarity and up-to-date instructions.
- Minor internal updates in code scripts (excel_generator.py, generate.py) for consistency with new versioning.
- No breaking changes; workflows, commands, and outputs remain unchanged.

**Summary:** Major update introducing compliance checking, versioning, CI templates, and improved output standards.

- Added compliance checker utility and corresponding unit tests.
- Introduced versioning utilities for better document/package management.
- Provided CI/CD templates for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI.
- Included Git hooks installation script.
- Enhanced output document naming conventions, directory structure, and styling standards.
- Improved and expanded test coverage, particularly for bidirectional sync and compliance logic.
- Updated documentation to reflect new features and standards.

- Added GAMP 5 Second Edition bilingual guidance to interactive category selection and templates.
- Improved documentation in README and SKILL.md for clarity on supported systems and usage.
- Enhanced requirements parsing and pre-generation process via CLI tools.
- General documentation updates and small refinements to templates (including RA and VSR).

csv-documentation-generator 1.1.2

- Updated documentation in CHANGELOG.md, README.md, and SKILL.md for clarity and accuracy.
- Enhanced and clarified templates for User Requirement Specification (URS) and Validation Summary Report (VSR).
- Small improvements and corrections to bilingual support and feature descriptions.
- Version number incremented to 1.1.2.

- Added details for Openclaw and Python version compatibility in metadata.
- Updated validation status to "beta".
- Included repository and bug tracker URLs.
- Introduced a new section describing the pre-generation requirements parsing capability using cli.py (parse requirements from source code markers).
- No changes to core functionality; documentation and metadata improvements only.

**Version 1.1.0 – Major update with new automation, audit, and requirements analysis features**

- Introduced several new modules: requirements parsing, risk analysis, audit logging, CLI, and test coverage.
- Added initial audit log and agent support for better traceability and execution management.
- Enhanced requirement management with dedicated parsing, linking, and risk analysis scripts.
- Added configuration files for easier setup (.csv-docs-config.json, requirements.json).
- Improved documentation with bilingual README and detailed changelogs (CHANGELOG.md, README_en.md).
- Extended core logic in generate.py, excel_generator.py, and word_generator.py to support new features and extensibility.

Initial release of CSV Documentation Generator.

- Generate Computerized System Validation (CSV) documentation for pharmaceutical and medical device industries.
- Supports bilingual (Chinese/English) templates and outputs in Word (.docx) and Excel (.xlsx) formats.
- Auto-creates and manages Python virtual environment with necessary dependencies.
- Provides interactive GAMP 5 (Second Edition) category selection with bilingual prompts.
- Includes commands for full set of validation documents: VP, URS, FS, TS, RA, IQ, OQ, PQ, RTM, VSR, checklist, and test-case templates.
- Built-in compliance checks for 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
